# Vendored: Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor

`token_extractor.py` is copied unmodified from
[PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor](https://github.com/PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor)
(MIT — see `LICENSE` in this directory), commit at time of vendoring:
`1782f79...` era clone, 2026-08-01. It logs into a Xiaomi cloud account and
dumps every linked device, including the `beaconkey` (BLE auth key) for
devices whose `did` contains `blt`.

This directory is MIT, deliberately kept separate from the rest of this
AGPLv3 repo — do not import AGPL code into this file or vice versa. It is
invoked as a subprocess by `src/miband/xiaomi_cloud.py` (AGPL), never
imported directly.

Requires extra dependencies not needed by the rest of the project:
`uv sync --extra xiaomi-cloud`.

Do not edit this file — if it needs a fix, patch it upstream and re-vendor.
